title: Heɗtiiɓe gila e ko yiyaaka
intro: Haa caggal 6uu6ol aduna yi’eteecfo oo, dental suucfngal ina moofti e nder ni66ere, ina 6uu6too e sawtawol ngol 6uu6ol ngol 6e nganndunoo fof. Ɓe njirlotonoo ko duuɓi keewɗi tawa ɓe ngalaa ɗowdi goonga, haa daande ɓuuɓnde e nder deeƴre laamu maɓɓe ngu yi’ataake, ɓuuɓna huunde luggiɗnde e nder ɓerɗe maɓɓe. Hannde jamma, on noddaama ngam yahrude yeeso e udditde mbaydi ndee fedde sirlu, nde kawral mum e konnguɗi diineeji addani ɗum en ruttaade e leñol mum en, jeertinooɓe goonga mo waawaano jogaade.
clues: Minen ko min tagooje ɓooyɗe, gonɗe ko ɓooyi ko adii leƴƴi keewɗi ɗi njanngu-ɗaa, tee min keewaani haaleede e daartol aadee.
Nafoore men wayi ko no tagoore mon nii, nde 6oornii ko e geɗe ɗe njiyataa, kadi eɗen njogii doole ɗe ƴaañii ko woodi.
Duuɓi keewɗi, min njillondirii min ngalaa ɗowdi goonga, haa daande yettii min ina ɓuuɓna huunde luggiɗnde e nder amen.
En nanii jaŋngugol hono no meeɗaa nande nii, konnguɗi jogiiɗi teddungal ɓurngal haala kala.
Min njuɓɓinii e nder sirlu, min njamirii koye amen yo deƴƴu, nde aayaaji ɗii njoofi, min mbaawaano heddaade.
Min ngartii e leñol amen, min mbiyi: “Eeh leñol amen, min nanii deftere jippinaande caggal Muusaa, ina tabitina ko adii ɗum, ina ardina e goonga.”

identity.answer: Jinnaaɓe gooŋɗinɓe caggal nde nani Alkuraan

trial.label: Ñaawoore / Kewu
options: En ndiiwaama ngam salaade sujjande yeeso tagoore hesere
Min ndarnaama e nder ngaska fotde duuɓi teemedde tati e jeenay
Min njamiraama yoo min taccu maayo fecciingo yeeso amen
Min neldaama leydi maagiyaŋkaagal ngam janngude maagiyaŋkaagal
En keɗiima jaŋngugol e nder sirlu, en mbayliima heen
trial.answer: En keɗiima jaŋngugol e nder sirlu, en mbayliima heen

location.answer: Deftere jippinaande caggal Muusaa, teegtinde Tawreeta

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Min kuɗaama haa ñalnde darnga
Min ummiima e laamɗo baawɗo, min mbaɗii ŋoral e nder leydi ndii
Min mbaylaama min ngonti ɓowɗi e baali
En ngartii e leñol men jeertinooɓe, bayyinooɓe iimanaagal
Min njippiima e maayo he sara gardiiɗo amen
outcome.answer: En ngartii e leñol men jeertinooɓe, bayyinooɓe iimanaagal

arabic: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا
verse: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone. (72:2)
